denial_text:
Arogya Plus Insurance Company Limited

Date: 03/10/2026

Claim No: APL/55100
Amount claimed: Rs. 93,000

Claim for cataract surgery in the first year with us. Member ported from another insurer after three years of continuous cover.

Reason for rejection: Cataract is a named treatment covered only after two years of membership under clause 2.3.

Regards,
Claims Team

Arogya Plus Insurance Company Limited

Date: 04/10/2026

Claim No: APL/55101
Amount claimed: Rs. 124,000

Claim partly paid after a suite-room stay for appendicitis.

Reason for rejection: Proportionate deduction applied to the full bill including medicines and implants because the room charge exceeded Rs 5,000 per day.

Regards,
Claims Team

Arogya Plus Insurance Company Limited

Date: 05/10/2026

Claim No: APL/55102
Amount claimed: Rs. 155,000

Claim for asthma admission. Member insured with us continuously for six years.

Reason for rejection: Non-disclosure of asthma in the application form. Claim repudiated under clause 6.1.

Regards,
Claims Team

Arogya Plus Insurance Company Limited

Date: 06/10/2026

Claim No: APL/55103
Amount claimed: Rs. 186,000

Claim for dialysis sessions, each lasting four hours.

Reason for rejection: Admission was less than 24 hours and does not qualify as in-patient hospitalisation.

Regards,
Claims Team

Arogya Plus Insurance Company Limited

Date: 07/10/2026

Claim No: APL/55104
Amount claimed: Rs. 217,000

Claim for emergency appendectomy. Insurer informed on day four as the member was in surgery and ICU.

Reason for rejection: Late intimation beyond two days of emergency admission.

Regards,
Claims Team

Arogya Plus Insurance Company Limited

Date: 08/10/2026

Claim No: APL/55105
Amount claimed: Rs. 248,000

Admission for abdominal pain; scans found a perforated ulcer which was operated in the same stay.

Reason for rejection: The admission was for investigation and evaluation purposes only and is excluded.

Regards,
Claims Team
